title: Linear bound for tribes influence
statement: Let $w$ and $s$ be nonnegative integers, and form the tribes function on $s$ blocks of $w$ signs each, taking the disjunction of the conjunctions on those blocks. Its total influence is at most twice the number of input coordinates, namely $2sw$.
